scope: Team-game experiment using only prior games. Pace is a neutral-game-clock proxy, not tracking-derived snap-to-snap time. Team tendencies are not attributed causally to individual coaches. No production projection scalar enabled.
implementation: Predict team plays P, expected dropback share q; D=P*q, designed rushes=P*(1-q). Subtract sacks/scrambles from D for pass attempts, add scrambles to player rushing opportunities, allocate by forecast target/carry shares. Preserve team totals. Context coefficients must be learned and validated; no automatic rest/body-clock penalty.
